terms: most intelligent thing in any room
ledgerSearch.outcome: The semantic review records that the baseline claimed the room had always been more intelligent than any person and that the pass corrected the scope to a room can become more intelligent through relation. That decision binds and is kept. CTD-0080 records that the Bateson and Buhner attributions remain unverified; both are restored as attributions, not as citations, and the item stays open.

findings.summary: The chamber's coda scaffold is not restored, and the pattern which connects was moved into the body.

evidence.baseline: It is, in the end, the pattern which connects, as Gregory Bateson named it, and Stephen Harrod Buhner carried forward after him.
evidence.shipped: This is, in Gregory Bateson's phrase, the pattern which connects, an idea Stephen Harrod Buhner later carried forward.

findings.authorizedBy: The voice card's known weak passages, and the semantic review's record of the coda removal.
findings.diagnosis: Coda scaffold not restored. The baseline closes this chamber with a divider, two italic address lines, the isolated line That is why, and a fourth italic line beginning That is why. The Volume VI voice card lists any return of the repeated divider plus That is why coda among its known weak passages, and the semantic review records the pass's removal of the scaffold as a structural repair. The address lines also tell the reader what they have felt, waited for, or were made to become, which is the defect CTD-0091 was opened for and which the corpus card forbids outright. The scaffold is therefore left removed. Where a coda carried content rather than performance, that content is restored into the chamber body. Here the fifth coda line carried the volume's only named intellectual lineage, so it is kept in the pass's placement inside the chamber body.

findings.summary: The three places insight lives were reduced to two and lost the friction.

evidence.baseline: in the question one person asks that unlocks another, in the trust that lets an idea be handed across without being dropped, in the friction of difference that strikes a light neither could have struck alone.
evidence.shipped: in a question that unlocks another thought, in the trust that lets an idea travel, or in disagreement that reveals what neither person could see alone.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.4 applied to the triad.
findings.diagnosis: Handed across without being dropped is a physical image for what trust does, and strikes a light is the only fire in the chamber. Travel and reveals are the same propositions with the images removed, which is what section 6 forbids doing to a sufficient image.

findings.summary: The chamber's closing verdict on where the leverage was, and where we spent an age instead, was cut.

evidence.baseline: We spent an age trying to sharpen the single mind. The leverage was always in the between, and we left it almost untouched.
evidence.shipped: We have invested heavily in sharpening individual minds and far less in tending the relations between them.

findings.diagnosis: The between is the chamber's title and its canonical term, and this is the only sentence that names it as the thing we neglected. Relations between them is a near synonym for the volume's own word, which the standard's register rule forbids substituting when the precision is equal.

debtImpact.note: The scope correction is kept: a room can be more intelligent than any person in it, rather than the room has never not been. Bateson and Buhner remain attributed and unverified, which is the state the item records.

reasoning.note: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF. The baseline's committing universal, that the most intelligent thing in any room has never been a person, was removed by the recorded scope correction and the hedged form kept. The decision is in the semantic review and R-LEDGER-WINS makes it final; the loss of the two-sentence reveal is the recorded cost of that decision, not an unrecorded cautious half.
R-CORRECTION-SCOPE. The scope correction governs the room's intelligence claim and stops there; the triad, the wisdom pair, and the closing verdict are the baseline's.

R-REFRAIN-COST. The divider plus That is why coda is a volume-wide refrain, removed once by one decision. The anchor record v06-the-current carries the refrain finding with its count of eleven; this chamber cites the anchor rather than repeating the analysis. The Bateson and Buhner coda line was content and is folded into the body, as the anchor's fold audit records.
R-PAIRED-DELETION. Term sweep run over the section's distinctive named terms against the baseline and the current corpus. No cross-reference was restored at one end; no dependency blocks.

R-DEIXIS and R-TENSE checked against the baseline's demonstratives and verb forms. Nothing fires. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD. No claim named in an open canon query was cut from this section by this audit or left unrecorded by generation A.
Nothing further fires. The prose stands as generation A left it.
